limitations: Symmetric positively weighted stars with at least two leaves; completed standard three-stage order-three RK endpoint only. No intermediate-stage guarantee above the forward-Euler limit. Potential unindexed equivalent historical specialization remains a priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof for all strictly positive conductances; exact-rational replay provides consistency checks, not a computer-assisted infinite proof.
title: A universal hub-diagonal positivity law for third-order Runge–Kutta on weighted stars
